finding.statement: The fused replay-stable Forge execution identity still included delta_id, and measured-evidence identity inherited delta_id through measured_packet. Earlier PR #1687 head 14a5f0e explicitly classified delta_id as candidate/evaluation-envelope identity whose re-key alone must remain duplicate, but that discriminator was absent from the later stronger fusion on main. A second-order migration issue also follows from changing hash semantics in place: persisted v1 hashes must remain recognizable after delta_id is removed or the first post-upgrade semantic replay can evade the new hash.
finding.goodhart_signal: A high-information discriminator present in an earlier donor revision disappeared while the implementation remained keyed by the field it was meant to exclude. Green remaining tests therefore did not cover the stronger stated replay invariant.

hypothesis: A versioned replay identity v2 that excludes delta_id, paired with explicit v1 compatibility matching against persisted historical delta_id/replay/measured hashes, restores semantic replay stability without rewriting append-only history or collapsing genuinely different measured executions.
counterhypothesis: delta_id is itself an execution identity and must distinguish separately admissible measurements.
counterhypothesis_disposition: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_CURRENT_DONOR_SEMANTICS: the earlier explicit regression documented delta_id as candidate/evaluation-envelope identity, while supervisor 8.73 requires replay identity to bind measured execution evidence rather than volatile envelope identity. Distinct measured executions remain separated by source/provenance, worker, repo/evaluation heads, targets, execution admission and metric identity.
